senses.gloss:
[Gaganadinamaṇi]
--C. Syādvādamañjarī on Dvātriṁśikāstavana. L. 1502. Mistake for Malliṣeṇa, described a. ‘Tattvadṛggaganadinamaṇi.’

[Gaṅgāstava]
attributed to Darāj-Khān; probably identical with Darāj-Khān who conquered Saptagrāma in Bengal.
See JASB. XVI. 1847, p.. 393 ff.; B. C. Law Vol. II. p. 182, fn. 6.

[Gaṅgāstava]
by Zafir Khan. also called Durap Khan. one verse of this, suradhuni munikanye tArayeH puNyavantaM etc. q. in JASB. XVI. 1847, p. 396. [Page224-a.

[Gandhahastimahābhāṣya]
by Siddhasena Divākara. ref. to by Yaśovijayagaṇi in his Nyāyakhaṇḍakhādya. C.. Jainagranthāvalī p. 88. Mistake for Siddhasenagaṇi's work.
See Prastāvanā, p. 19, Tattvārthādhigamasūtra, Seth Devchand Lalbhai Jain Pustakoddhar Fund Ser. no. 76.

[Garuḍadhvajastotra]
in 19 verses. spoken by Dhruva. Same a. Bhāgavata, Sk. IV. adhy. 9.
Pt.. Bṛ. St. Ratnākara, p.. 92-93. Paṇḍita Pustakālaya. Kāśī, 1950.
